scope: Research and measurement design for custom Wi-Fi broadcast. ESP-NOW remains excluded from delivered transport. No new Wi-Fi hardware result.
hypothesis: CPU interrupt masking, Wi-Fi task starvation, TX-buffer ownership/completion failure, or RF coexistence can create apparent packet loss. These are separate mechanisms and must not be merged into one assumed cause.

sources.finding: WIFI_PS_NONE disables modem sleep but does not override RF coexistence. Wi-Fi still sleeps in non-Wi-Fi radio slices.
sources.implication: Continuous CPU execution and disabled modem sleep do not prove continuous receiver availability.

sources.finding: RF is priority-arbitrated between Wi-Fi, BR/EDR and LE; priority is dynamic. Sniffer RX with Bluetooth is classified supported but unstable.
sources.implication: Raw broadcast framing alone does not establish a stable Bluetooth coexistence path.

sources.kind: open user-reported issue; different silicon, not a confirmed shared root cause
sources.finding: A native-IDF reporter described callback-paced single-in-flight sends:218562 accepted,218530 successful callbacks,32 timeouts/reinitializations, then persistent NO_MEM with a32-entry cache and healthy general heap.
sources.limitation: Buffer retention is a reported correlation. Maintainer explicitly requested separate tracking for differing reports. No proof that original ESP32 raw802.11 has the same fault.

sources.finding: Espressif confirms ESP-NOW uses802.11 PHY/MAC and DCF. This consecutive-loss investigation was ultimately attributed by its reporter to the UART pipeline;500-600Hz reception became minimally lossy after pipeline changes.
sources.implication: A reported sequence gap outside the receive callback is not automatically a radio/driver drop.

sources.finding: Public raw802.11 TX completion callback runs in the Wi-Fi task; heavy callback work can impair Wi-Fi performance.
sources.implication: Use bounded in-memory event records. No serial, allocation, audio decode, blocking waits or synchronous flash writes in Wi-Fi callbacks. Completion remains distinct from peer delivery.

hold_fixed: fixed frame content CRC and session/sequence
bluetooth_states: actual A2DP plus continuous BLE controls
additional_comparisons: paced sends versus deliberately bounded bursts at the same average offered load
actual default power-save settings versus explicitly documented awake settings; do not equate PS_NONE with RF ownership
controlled_comparisons.no_artificial_pause: Within an active coexistence measurement, keep music and BLE running. State setup pauses separately.

observations.limitation: Task latency is not proof of IRQ masking or RF ownership. Do not label enqueue-to-callback duration RF airtime.

fault_classification: Offered but API rejected: host/driver admission or resource pressure.
Accepted with missing completion and growing outstanding count: investigate driver ownership, worker scheduling and completion path before raising the send rate.
Completion but missing RX callback: RF availability, loss, filtering or pre-callback RX handling remain candidates; two-board counters alone cannot uniquely locate this boundary.
RX callback present but validation/audio missing: local buffer, consumer or deadline issue.
Loss only after enabling Bluetooth: coexistence or CPU-resource contention becomes evidence-supported; distinguish these by recorded scheduling state and controlled Bluetooth states.
Loss with Bluetooth fully disabled: Bluetooth switching cannot be the sole cause.
recovery_policy: Save terminal evidence before any driver reset. Do not declare automatic restart a continuous-audio fix.
current_state: No Wi-Fi firmware built, flashed, or RF-qualified in this new project.
important_inference: The source obtaining a Wi-Fi radio grant does not establish that a peer is listening; its radio may be assigned to Bluetooth at that moment. This is a candidate explanation for burst loss with healthy CPU scheduling, not a measured result on these boards. Spacing redundant copies across time may help only after measured gap distributions and available airtime justify it.
